label: preparing
what: A coordinated jubilee gathering celebrating my forty years as mayor is being prepared in the great hall for day 1 at 18:00, under cover of a lighting inspection with builder escort. Freight coordinates bread deliveries and lanterns, the baker supplies bread, and the innkeeper helps with bread orders and flour supplies. The builder is involved in the escort and lighting arrangements, though his knowledge of the full surprise is less certain. The secretary knowingly helps coordinate and report logistics. The gathering was originally a surprise, but the secretary has now told me about it; bread quantities, funding and timely fresh supply remain uncertain.
